overview:
Mcginning to believe remains top of the pile after another solid 94 points, but DuncanDisorder is now just 7 points behind after edging them this week with 95. The big mover was Dragospear's XI, who rocketed from 13th to 5th after the highest score of the week - an impressive 101 points. Livesdownthelaine also climbed three places into 3rd, while Gayfield of Dreams jumped four places to 7th. It was a tougher week for Wards Wanderers, who dropped from 3rd to 11th, while MattyCashInTheAttic also slipped four places to 9th. With just 12 points separating 3rd to 7th, things are getting very tight behind the top two.

The Premier League served up plenty of drama too. Arsenal maintained their perfect start with a 2-0 win at Sunderland, while Liverpool were held to a goalless draw by Fulham and Chelsea could only manage 2-2 against newly promoted Hull. Brighton smashed Coventry 5-0, while the Manchester derby saw City beat United 1-0 despite playing with 10 men for more than an hour after Phil Foden’s early red card. Haaland grabbed the winner, although the goal was surrounded by controversy after a lengthy VAR check. Leeds then rounded off the weekend with an emphatic 4-1 win over Newcastle.

Four gameweeks down, Mcginning to believe still leads the way - but with the chasing pack bunching up, there's plenty of opportunity for someone to make a move.

otherUpdates.title: We need Your Feedback!
otherUpdates.content: We would love your feedback on these updates - anything you like, dislike or would like to see more of? Maybe you've got a shout out, a grudge you want to air or something else you would like included in the update - just let me know via the WhatsApp group and I'll add it to the update for the following week.
